         a.standard_flag,

         a.standard_text_value
  FROM activities a
  INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
  INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
  INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id

    AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
    AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS pref_name,

       cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
       cr.compound_key AS compound_key

INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act_data.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
INNER JOIN assays ass ON act_data.activity_id = a.activity_id
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON act_data.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE md.pref_name IS NOT NULL
  AND ass.description IS NOT NULL
  AND act_data.standard_value IS NOT NULL
;
